analyst.summary: Cemindia Projects (the former ITD Cementation, now under Adani Group control) is riding a genuinely large, growing order book (Rs 24,545 crore, a record) that gives good multi-year revenue visibility. But the blockbuster recent quarter that helped drive the stock up 156% in three months was, by management's own admission, boosted by roughly Rs 100 crore of one-off arbitration claim settlements and provision reversals - not a step-change in normal contracting margins - and another one-off arbitration award (Rs 212.54 crore) was disclosed just yesterday and will flow through a future quarter. We would treat the recent growth and margin numbers with real caution rather than extrapolate them, even though the underlying order book and new-parent backing are genuine positives; a Hold on fundamentals, with a flag for the desk that the stock's recent re-rating may be running ahead of sustainable earning power.
